physical.statistics_scope: Completed routes only. Every requested seed is retained in attempts; an incomplete route has no frequency.
physical.timing_model: Partial-path estimate from pinned openXC7: BRAM and registered DSP timing are excluded; flip-flop setup/hold/clock-to-Q use fixed 0.1 ns values; shared zynq7 tables do not select a speed grade. This is not a design-wide maximum clock or vendor signoff.

prediction: Smaller population should ease congestion and improve modeled clock versus D3; scheduler ready/completion paths may still dominate.
